parts:
Yes, this is still the problem. Hadoop doesn;t necc load your bash_profile files. Basically launching this

R CMD /import/linux/home/bsendir1/R-
INSTALL/RCONF/lib64/R/library/Rhipe/bin/RhipeMapReduce --slave --silent --vanilla

is failing.

You might want to instead set the runner to some script file (executable), accessible by everyone and sets
the environment vars and exec R CMD /import/linux/home/bsendir1/R-
INSTALL/RCONF/lib64/R/library/Rhipe/bin/RhipeMapReduce --slave --silent --vanilla
